title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. 1. We have named a child Subhan Ahmed Keen, knowing Subhan is name of Allah Subhan wa tallah but since it does not come in the 99 names of Allah we thought it was ok to use it. Now we have read in Maaruf ul Quraan where Mufti Shafi says that except 4-5 names of Allah other names (he mentions Subhan cannot be used; on page 134 Vol4, Aayat 180 of Surat Al Aaraaf) cannot be used. Please guide us. 5060 views Q. Can a boy be named ARHAM? 8858 views Q. My 2 years old nephew's name is Rehaab (رحاب). Is it a good Islamic name? And what does it mean? 2291 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 18550 Country: India Title: Baby BOY names: MIRAN-UL HAQUE; MIZAN-UL HAQUE; AREEB-UL HAQUE; MUBID-UL HAQUE; ASAD-UL HAQUE Question: Assalam-o-alaikum I am blessed with a Baby BOY. Please tell me the meaning of MIRAN-UL HAQUE; MIZAN-UL HAQUE; AREEB-UL HAQUE; MUBID-UL HAQUE; ASAD-UL HAQUE ? Which among the above is NOT permissible as per Sharia? Also request to kindly suggest me few good name in samer pattern? Wassalam Answer ID: 18550 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 50/50/H=1431) All the names except Mubid-ul-Haq are correct. (1) The amir of truth, (2) the scale of truth, (3) expert in truth, (4) not correct (5) the lion of truth (2) Sayeedul Haq, Shaheedul Haq, Abidul Haq, Shareeful Haq, Naseerul Haq, Azeezul Haq, Ameedul Haq, Ameenul Haq. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
